contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A highly worn and degraded 4th century roman nummus (AE2) of Constantine I (r. 309-337), minted at London AD 317 .SOL INVIC-TO COMITI, Sol standing left, holding globe and raising hand Reverse type. Mintmark PL:N or PLN. As RIC VII London 123. Obverse: Laureate and cuirassed bust right. Legend: '[CONSTANTINVS P AVG]'. Reverse: Sol standing left, holding globe and raising hand.
